summary: On May 11, 2026, Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its board authorized a $2.0 billion expansion of its ongoing share repurchase program. As of March 31, 2026, the company had ~104 million shares outstanding and has repurchased ~230 million shares for ~$17.4 billion since program inception. Shares may be repurchased through open-market or private transactions, and the company may enter a Rule 10b5-1 plan. The program has no fixed number of shares, can be suspended or discontinued, and will be funded from working capital. Watch for potential tender offers or accelerated buyback execution.
